note: Throwable discs (D-069), keyed by item id (data/items/items.json). Flight numbers on the usual speed / glide / turn / fade scale (turn < 0 = drifts right on a right-hand backhand at full speed, fade = hooks left as it slows); full_speed_mps = launch speed at full power. Tuned in DiscFlightRules for ~110 m / 80 m / 55 m at full power on flat ground. color = RGB of the plastic. Looks (D-117, DiscMesh, presentation only): shape = rim profile in metres (diameter, height, rim_width = nose to inner rim wall, rim_depth = bottom of the rim to the underside of the flight plate, dome = how much the flight plate rises in the middle, nose 0 = sharp low nose .. 1 = blunt round putter nose), plastic = roughness / clearcoat / wear (0..1 scuffs), stamp = hot-stamp foil colour + design (ring | star | bison). Real-world-like proportions (driver ~21.1 cm x 1.45 cm, 2.2 cm rim; mid ~21.7 x 1.9, 1.3 cm rim; putter ~21.2 x 2.1, 1.0 cm rim), no real brands.
